name: tattlehop
description: Keeps a receipt of what each agent command changed on your PC outside the repo. Needs the Tattlehop app.

hook_path.title: tattlehop-hook.exe
hook_path.description: Where Tattlehop installed tattlehop-hook.exe, usually %LOCALAPPDATA%\Tattlehop\current\tattlehop-hook.exe. The Tattlehop tray app shows the exact path.
